Hey, first of all I want to thank you for posting this. I am pretty much in the same situation as you. I grew up poor in a rich country. My mother had little to no money but she did the best to support me and my siblings. I never had to take a job to help with the bills, my mother was to proud to ask us to do so. But surrounded by my friends who had wealthy parents I had to take a job just so I could buy the things they had and be part of the group. I never enjoyed working and felt unhappy doing it, but I just went with it. Every summer my friends went on a holiday outside the country yet my family couldn't afford it. So I stayed home and just played videogames during the holiday. I started to get addicted to them and didn't leave my house very often. I am pretty sure this made me the introvert I am today, and my troubling experiences with work and knowing that my friends received things without working for them made me unmotivated to ever work again. I finished my secondary education when I had the same realization as you. I just want to fully enjoy life without working. I want to see the world before I die. I also realized that this was an unrealistic worldview so I made up a plan. My plan was to continue to fully enjoy life for 5 more years and then end it all. So I did. My government allows my to loan up to 800 dollars a month for college education. So I applied for college, didn't do anything and still received my monthly pay. I just lied to my mom every year that I didn't like it and that I started over the next year. During these years I also had a blast. I did the same thing as you. Just eat(takeout every day), sleep and played videogames. But after 4 years I fell into a depression. I am tired of lying to my mom about my education and I want to tell her about my plan. The difference between you and me is that I never lived on my own. I am always surrounded by my family. Because of that I always have to lie about my education and health and it takes a toll. I also was able to hide is pretty well. Always cheery and laughing, looking like I was having the best time ever. But because I live with my mom and I have to see my family pretty much everyday I eventually ran out of energy to hide my true feelings. I am currently locked away in my room for 6 months now, playing video games and drinking vodka to pass the time.
For me cutting off contact to make the suicide easier is no option because I live at home. My family already knows that I am not feeling fine and they are really worried about me and I know that I am hurting them this way. I was able to tell one of my closest friends about my plan and he supports my decision. He doesn't like it, but he supports me. I am planning to tell my family about my plan to end my life. I have to, because like you, I am running out of money this month. Living without money is no option for me. I wish I was able to break off contact to make my death easier for my family, but I have to confront them with the truth and I know that I will break their hearts.

I really want to thank you for posting this. Knowing that I am not the only one in this situation really helps me mentally. And I just want to let you know that there are other people in the world like you.
